hints.title: Sign Consideration
hints.text: Consider how positive and negative numbers influence the overall product.

hints.title: Pairing Negatives
hints.text: All positive numbers should be included, while negative numbers should be paired up in even quantities.

hints.title: Discard Smallest Magnitude Negative
hints.text: Sort negative numbers; if their count is odd, drop the one closest to zero.

hints.title: Greedy Product Assembly

complexity.notes: Sorting negatives allows discarding the largest negative cleanly.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all 2^n subsets exceeds reasonable time constraints.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Separating values by sign requires linear auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handles edge cases like single elements and all-negative arrays with zeroes.
